findings.explicitAddressPrecedence: Existing explicit private addresses fail InvalidIPAddress.InUse before token comparison, even for an identical retry.
findings.automaticRetries: Matching automatic-IP retries return the same ENI and its current description, groups and addresses; response status remains pending and TagSet echoes the current request without changing retained tags.
findings.comparison: Groups are a set; changed description/subnet/secondary count mismatch. Tags and their ordering do not affect the token. Absent description/groups equal empty values, but absent InterfaceType differs from explicit interface.
findings.deleted: Matching token after deletion fails IdempotentParameterMismatch.
findings.syntax: Outer ASCII whitespace is trimmed; 65-byte and Unicode tokens were accepted. Case-only change mismatched; blank tokens returned InternalError and XML control returned InvalidCharacter.
findings.bounds: No long-retention interval measured. AWS InternalError outcomes are retained evidence, not a local success or an invented failure state machine.
